content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. 💪 Research shows that sets taken close to failure (about 0–3 reps left in the tank) build similar muscle across a wide range of loads, roughly 5–30 reps. Lighter weights just cost you more fatigue and time.

Your goal is a 100 kg bench in three months, so you do need heavy work, because strength is specific to the load you train with. Mix heavy sets of 3–6 reps on the main lifts with 8–15 rep sets for accessories. Ain't nothin' but a peanut! 🏋️
